propositions.name: aether_exists
propositions.statement: There is an aether in the laboratory and in space.
propositions.quote: is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion.

propositions.name: michelson_morley_negative
propositions.statement: The Michelson-Morley experiment gave a well-known negative result in which interference takes place between two rays, one travelling to and fro in the direction of the earth's motion and the other to and fro in a perpendicular direction.
propositions.quote: well-known negative result of the Michelson-Morley experiment in which interference takes place between two rays, one travelling to and fro in the direction of the earth's motion, and the other to and fro in a perpendicular direction

propositions.name: negative_result_implies_aether_shares_motion
propositions.statement: The negative result is interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion.

propositions.name: stellar_aberration_favours_stationary_aether
propositions.statement: Stellar aberration favours the theory of a stationary aether.
propositions.quote: But other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether.

propositions.name: fitzgerald_lorentz_contraction_hypothesis
propositions.statement: Solid bodies alter their relative dimensions when rotated in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for.
propositions.quote: solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions, when rotated, in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for.

propositions.name: deformation_moving_through_aether_causes_double_refraction
propositions.statement: A deformation of matter when moving through the aether might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction.
propositions.quote: such a deformation of matter when moving through the rather might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction

propositions.name: double_refraction_onset_detectable_with_delicacy
propositions.statement: The beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy.
propositions.quote: as the beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy, I thought that even a small chance of arriving at a positive result justified a careful experiment.

propositions.name: liquids_show_no_double_refraction_of_expected_order
propositions.statement: For liquids there is no double refraction of the order to be expected, comparable with the single refraction.
propositions.quote: there is no double refraction of the order to be expected, that is comparable with 10 of the single refraction.

propositions.name: liquid_can_exhibit_double_refraction_under_electric_stress
propositions.statement: The liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress.
propositions.quote: the liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress, as is shown in Dr. Kerr's experiments.

propositions.name: light_polarized_by_nicol
propositions.statement: Light is polarized by the nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal.
propositions.quote: was polarized by the first nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal at 45°.

propositions.name: board_orientation_determines_transverse_motion
propositions.statement: When the board stands north and south, the earth's motion is transverse and the situation is such as to exhibit any double refraction which may ensue.
propositions.quote: When at 12 o'clock the board stands north and south, the earth's motion is transverse and the situation is such as to exhibit any double refraction which may ensue.

propositions.name: vibrations_parallel_vs_transverse_to_motion
propositions.statement: Luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion are propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion, i. e. east and west, are propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion, i. e. vertical.

propositions.name: east_west_orientation_gives_no_double_refraction
propositions.statement: When the board points east and west, both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, so no double refraction could manifest itself.
propositions.quote: both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, and therefore no double refraction could manifest itself.

propositions.name: no_effect_from_180_degree_rotation
propositions.statement: No effect is to be expected from a rotation of the board through 180°.
propositions.quote: In no case is any effect to be expected from a rotation through 180°

propositions.name: effect_second_order_in_velocity_ratio
propositions.statement: Any effect from a rotation through 90° must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light.
propositions.quote: such effect as a rotation through 90° may entail must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light.

propositions.name: earth_orbital_motion_relevant
propositions.statement: According to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do with the motion of the earth in its orbit and with the motion of the sun in space.
propositions.quote: according to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do not only with the motion of the earth in its orbit, but also with that of the sun in space.

propositions.name: sun_motion_toward_hercules
propositions.statement: The motion of the sun is much the smaller and is directed towards the constellation Hercules.
propositions.quote: The latter is supposed to be much the smaller, and to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules.

propositions.name: april_motions_conspire
propositions.statement: In the month of April the two motions approximately conspire.
propositions.quote: In the month of April, when successful experiments were first made, the two motions would approximately conspire.

propositions.name: strained_glass_produces_double_refraction
propositions.statement: The strained condition of the glass produces a double refraction such as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether.
propositions.quote: the strained condition of the glass produces just such a double refraction as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether, so that the existence of the latter would be evidenced by a displacement of the dark band

propositions.name: band_position_precisely_observable
propositions.statement: The slightest motion of the band is rendered evident by changes in the feeble illumination just inside the wires.
propositions.quote: The slightest motion of the band is rendered evident by changes in the feeble illumination just inside the wires.

propositions.name: gas_tubes_could_bias_rotation
propositions.statement: The gas-leading tubes are connected in such a manner as to give rise to no forces which could appreciably vary as the board turns.
propositions.quote: The gas-leading tubes are connected in such a manner as to give rise to no forces which could appreciably vary as the board turns.

propositions.name: no_band_shift_observed
propositions.statement: In neither case could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position.
propositions.quote: In neither case could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position, whether at noon or at 6 p.m.

propositions.name: earth_magnetism_rotates_polarization_plane
propositions.statement: In consequence of the earth's magnetism there must be a rotation of the plane of polarization when the light traverses the bisulphide of carbon in the north and south position.
propositions.quote: In consequence of the earth's magnetism there must be a rotation of the plane of polarization when the light traverses the bisulphide of carbon in the north and south position

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_proportional_to_potential_and_length
propositions.statement: For one C.G.S. unit of magnetic potential the rotation in bisulphide of carbon at 18° is .042 minute of angle.
propositions.quote: For one C.G.S. unit of magnetic potential the rotation in CS 2 at 18° is .042 minute of angle.

propositions.name: calculated_magnetic_rotation_value_below_limit
propositions.statement: The whole rotation of the plane of polarization to be expected is .58 minutes, so small that it would show itself, if at all, by a fading and not by a displacement of the band, and is below the limit of observation.
propositions.quote: 76 x .18 x .042 = .58'. So small a rotation of the plane, which would show itself, if at all, by a fading and not by a displacement of the band, is below the limit of observation.

propositions.name: revived_light_proportional_to_sin_squared_theta
propositions.statement: If θ be the angle of rotation of the nicol, the revived light is sin²θ, expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols.
propositions.quote: If θ be this angle, the revived light is sin²θ, expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols.

propositions.name: retardation_half_lambda_equals_90_degree_rotation
propositions.statement: If the retardation amounted to ½λ, the effect would be the same as of a rotation of the nicol through 90°.
propositions.quote: If this retardation amounted to ½λ, λ being the wave-length, the effect would be the same as of a rotation of the nicol through 90°.

propositions.name: general_retardation_revival_relation
propositions.statement: A retardation of phase ε, in place of π, gives a revival of light measured by sin²(½ε).
propositions.quote: a retardation of phase ε, in place of π, gives a revival of light measured by sin²(½ε).

propositions.name: band_location_more_delicate_than_revival_observation
propositions.statement: As actually carried out by location of the band, the test must be many times more delicate than the test made by simple observation of the revival of light.
propositions.quote: As actually carried out by location of the band, the test must be many times more delicate.

propositions.name: four_minute_rotation_detectable
propositions.statement: A marked fading of the band attended a rotation of the nicol through 4'.
propositions.quote: It was found that a marked fading of the band attended a rotation of the nicol through 4'.

propositions.name: loaded_glass_strip_produces_double_refraction
propositions.statement: The double refraction due to the loads on the strip of glass is of exactly the character to be tested for.
propositions.quote: The double refraction due to the loads is of exactly the character to be tested for, and accordingly this method affords a very direct check.

propositions.name: load_effect_inversely_proportional_to_width
propositions.statement: The effect of the load is independent of the length of the strip and of its thickness along the line of vision, but is inversely as the width.
propositions.quote: the effect is independent of the length of the strip and of its thickness along the line of vision, but is inversely as the width.

propositions.name: fifty_gram_load_shifts_band
propositions.statement: With the strip of width 15 mm, a total load of 50 grams caused a marked shifting of the band, while 25 grams was just perceptible.
propositions.quote: the application (or removal) of a total of 50 gms. caused a marked shifting of the band, while 25 gms. was just perceptible with certainty.

propositions.name: wertheim_load_retardation_relation
propositions.statement: It requires a load of 10 kilograms per millimetre of width to give a relative retardation of ½λ.
propositions.quote: who found that it requires a load of 10 kilograms per millimetre of width to give a relative retardation of ½λ

propositions.name: bisulphide_length_contains_wavelengths
propositions.statement: In the length of 76 cm of bisulphide of carbon there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths.
propositions.quote: In this length there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths.

propositions.name: margin_of_delicacy_for_liquid
propositions.statement: The double refraction that might be detected, estimated as a fraction of the whole refraction, leaves nearly 100 times to spare compared with the effect to be expected.
propositions.quote: Thus the double refraction that might be detected, estimated as a fraction of the whole refraction, is 1.2 × 10 . The effect to be expected is of the order 10 , so that there is nearly 100 times to spare.

propositions.name: solid_matter_harder_to_test
propositions.statement: When the liquid is replaced by solid matter, the difficulties of experiment are greatly increased.
propositions.quote: When it is attempted to replace the liquid by solid matter, the difficulties of experiment are greatly increased.

propositions.name: thick_single_piece_glass_exhibits_strain_double_refraction
propositions.statement: A sufficient thickness of glass in one piece is liable to exhibit too much double refraction from the effect of internal strains.
propositions.quote: A sufficient thickness in one piece is liable to exhibit too much double refraction from the effect of internal strains.

propositions.name: solid_experiments_still_show_no_double_refraction
propositions.statement: Even for solids there is no double refraction of the order to be expected due to motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: enough remains to justify us in concluding that even here there is no double refraction (of the order to be expected) due to motion through the aether.
